values.note: DCNR state forest motorized campsite rate (a state forest program, not a state park one). The $6.50 reservation fee is non-refundable and charged once per booking.

fees.source: The ReserveAmerica page for this site showed NO price block on any of the three dates queried (the other sites of the same forests show 'Residents of PA $10.00 Per Night', 'Non-Residents $15.00 Per Night', 'Reservation Fees $6.50'), so the rate rests on the agency's own page. https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/what-to-do/stay-overnight/overnight-prices-and-policies ('Motorized roadside, hike-in roadside, equestrian, and rustic campsites can be reserved for a fee of $10.00 a night for Pennsylvania residents and $15.00 a night for non-residents')

values.note: Check-in and check-out are 3 pm. After a stay, 48 hours off state forest land before camping again.

note: A gravel pull-through beside Jamison Run Road in the Hunter Run tract, under conifers, with a picnic table and fire ring; the pad is listed at 13 ft wide. Reach it only from the north: PA 36, Neilltown Road about 2.1 miles, then Jamison Run Road about 1.4 miles (GPS units may call it Depot Street). PennDOT has closed the rest of Jamison Run/Dawson Run Road for erosion (advisory read November 2026), and the agency says it may be necessary to drive past 'Road Closure' signs to reach the site. Oil-field traffic uses the roads in this part of the forest. Pack out trash. --Claude
summary: Site page re-read: 001 Cornplanter still listed and bookable online, Drive-In, RV/Tent/Trailer categories, 60 ft, gravel pull-through (confirmed), clearance 14 ft. DCNR Cornplanter advisories: 'The Pennsylvania Department of Transportation has closed part of Jamison Run/Dawson Run Road due to significant erosion issues. Cornplanter State Forest's motorized campsite is still accessible from the northern access of Jamison Run Road.' The site stays bookable; not a closure of the campsite, so no status was written.
